evidence: Smallest submission satisfying the brief is a full-stack Express+SQLite app built from an empty workspace: environment/Dockerfile leaves /app holding only .gitkeep (same as the template), and instruction.md asks for signed-in matter chat with ethical walls across list/search/thread/quote/unread/mentions/links/transcripts, disappearing-message timers measured against a fixed clock, partner-only legal holds, threaded replies 3+ deep, edit history with stale-edit refusal, safe formatting, mentions with autocomplete, per-user unread lines, idempotent sends, ~10 s live updates without losing drafts, search, transcripts and restart persistence (notes conversations.md, walls-and-retention.md, integration.md). The golden needs 528 lines of server.js plus 654 lines of client app.js. Stub exclusion is structural: tests/test.sh:68-69 exits with the pre-written zero reward when /app/server.js is absent, and :124 when the server never answers; a static shell or mock fails the render gate (authenticated_render needs wrong-password refusal and Gwen's seeded matters/messages) and the constraints gate (server_backed_local_application posts JUDGE-G1, reloads, and reads it back from Harriet in a separate context). tools/score.py:47-48 additionally zeroes reward unless functional > 0.05 (scoring.toml floors), and every one of the 16 functional criteria (total weight 42) requires server-backed operations, so a dead app scores 0 functional even if a gate were misjudged. Weak-app probe: a generic chat that imports the seed, signs in, posts, threads replies, edits/deletes and polls (no walls, timers, holds, transcript or idempotency) could plausibly pass only nested_replies 1.5, live_updates_keep_my_work 1.5 and perhaps safe_formatting 1.5 (~4.5/42 = 0.107 functional), giving a small partial reward; that is itself substantial real build work, not a stub or trivial tweak, so it does not violate this row. No conforming full build is blocked by this row's concern. Limits: this is a source/design review; no configured judge run or reward-discrimination measurement on these bytes exists (raw-evidence-index scope), so actual gate behaviour against a stub is not measured here, but the floor and missing-entry exits make the stub outcome independent of judge accuracy.
